description: THE DISORDER GLASS-BOX (block 199000) on top of 196000 staleness_decay + 198000 demotion_hierarchy. A faulty decay/demotion system IS a class of mental illness -- a PARAMETRIC fault on the landed machinery, an explicit graph-resident knob. TWO disorders, both DEMOTION FAILURES: (1) OBSESSION/RUMINATION = a SELF-REFRESHING LOOP -- the pathological attention->refresh coupling is LITERALLY an edge, retina -ruminates_on-> HierTrace; dis_ruminate (order 0, before dh_freshness) resets last_refresh_epoch = now_epoch every tick, so dh_freshness reads dEpoch=0 -> freshness=C0 -> the trace stays FRESH and NEVER demotes (positive feedback, dwelling keeps it fresh, crowds capacity). Snip the ruminates_on edge -> the rule cannot match -> surprise-gated decay resumes -> it demotes -> resolves. (2) PTSD/non-extinction = a held THREAT-SURFACE that WON'T DEMOTE -- a mis-set LARGE half_life makes IDiv(dEpoch,half_life)=0 -> freshness=C0 -> stays FRESH; dis_present_readout (order 5, after dh_tier/dh_demote) exposes experienced_as_present = (freshness>=t_present ? 1 : 0), the graph's own present-vs-past decision, so a stuck-FRESH threat reads 'present' (re-experienced, extinction failing). Restore a normal half_life -> demotes to gist -> reads 'past' -> resolves. Both are PURE knobs (the ruminates_on edge / the half_life attribute; nothing else changes). Understanding not judgment: the machinery does exactly what its knob says -- the aberrant-precision/aberrant-salience account (Kapur; Friston/Corlett; extinction-failure PTSD), precision=freshness in the Kalman-decay. Integer-native (Ashr/IDiv/IfThenElse/Gte/Eq only). OFF by default: rules need a HeldDisorderParams node the adapter creates only on opt-in; absent it every existing path is byte-identical. NO Rust, NO new Term.

microtheory.description: A faulty decay/demotion system is a class of symptom. Obsession = a self-refreshing loop (attention refreshes the trace, it never demotes, crowds capacity); PTSD = a long-half_life threat surface that won't demote to gist so it is re-experienced as present. Both are explicit graph-resident knobs; turning the knob restores health. Understanding the mechanism, not judging the person.
